test_title: PYST 54: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 08 Sept, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Why is Sanskrit counted among the modern Indian languages by the Constitution of India?

options.text: Given its designation as India's national language
Because it continues to be actively used
Due to its status as the most ancient classical language
As it serves as the linguistic root for all contemporary Indian languages

solution:
The correct answer is __**Because it continues to be actively used**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Sanskrit** is recognized as a modern Indian language under the Constitution of India because it continues to be actively used in academic, religious, and cultural domains.
 
• The language serves as a medium for **traditional Hindu rituals, scholarly pursuits, and ancient Indian literature**, keeping it relevant in contemporary society.
 
• Sanskrit is actively taught and spoken in some regions, such as in **villages like Mattur (Karnataka) and Jhiri (Madhya Pradesh)**, where it remains a part of daily communication.
 
• It is utilized in **modern scientific and technical terminology** to coin new words, ensuring its adaptability and continued relevance.
 
• **Government initiatives**, such as Sanskrit universities and language promotion schemes, contribute to the preservation and active use of Sanskrit in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India has **11 classical languages**, including the original six (Tamil, Sanskrit, Kannada, Telugu, Malayalam, Odia) and

 
 
• five recently added in 2024 (Marathi, Pali, Prakrit, Assamese, Bengali), recognized for their antiquity, distinct literary heritage, and cultural importance, with
 
• Tamil being the first declared in 2004.
 
 
 
• These languages have ancient, original texts and a rich, distinct literary tradition, distinct from modern usage, and are promoted by the government for their cultural preservation.
